completion_promises.criterion_text: LOG_PREFIX_QUEUE_BUILD is removed from tools/dispatch.py; the Phase 2 stub paragraph is removed from the tool docstring; the rest of the docstring is preserved verbatim.
completion_promises.evidence: Verified in turn 1; unchanged in turn 2. dispatch.LOG_PREFIX_QUEUE_BUILD attribute is absent (TestStubAnchorRetired), and the JARVIS_QUEUE_BUILD_STUB literal is absent from the module source.

queue_build calls await asyncio.wait_for(js.publish(subject, payload_bytes), timeout=timeout_seconds), where timeout_seconds is resolved via _resolve_publish_timeout() reading config.pipeline_publish_timeout_seconds. test_publish_uses_asyncio_wait_for_with_config_timeout asserts the wait_for timeout matches the config value.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Subject is constructed via nats_core.Topics.Pipeline.BUILD_QUEUED.format(...); hard-coded subject strings absent.
completion_promises.evidence: subject = Topics.Pipeline.BUILD_QUEUED.format(feature_id=feature_id) is the only subject construction. test_publish_called_once_with_canonical_subject asserts the subject equals the Topics-template value.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Payload uses nats_core.events.BuildQueuedPayload verbatim — no Jarvis-specific wire extensions.
completion_promises.evidence: BuildQueuedPayload(...) is constructed with the spec fields. test_publish_called_once_with_canonical_subject decodes the published bytes back through BuildQueuedPayload.model_validate.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Envelope source_id='jarvis' always; never read from the reasoning model's arg.
completion_promises.evidence: MessageEnvelope is constructed with source_id='jarvis' as a literal. test_publish_called_once_with_canonical_subject asserts envelope.source_id == 'jarvis' on the published bytes.

completion_promises.criterion_text: originating_adapter resolved from Session.adapter when a session is active; arg-as-fallback only when no session is active.
completion_promises.evidence: _resolve_originating_adapter() projects Session.adapter through _SESSION_ADAPTER_TO_ORIGINATING ({cli->terminal, telegram->telegram, dashboard->dashboard, reachy->voice-reachy}); arg fallback only when no session. test_no_session_uses_arg_value, test_session_adapter_overrides_arg, test_register_correlation_uses_session_id cover both branches.

completion_promises.criterion_text: On PubAck timeout: returns {'status': 'degraded', 'reason': 'transport_unavailable', ...} per ADR-ARCH-021; never raises.
completion_promises.evidence: TimeoutError from asyncio.wait_for is caught and returns _queue_build_degraded_error('transport_unavailable', ...). test_timeout_returns_degraded_transport_unavailable asserts the JSON shape.

When _dispatch_semaphore.try_acquire() returns False, queue_build returns degraded JSON BEFORE any publish attempt. test_saturation_returns_degraded asserts the JSON and that publish was never called.

When _nats_client is None or client.js raises, queue_build returns degraded JSON. NATSConnectionError on publish is also caught. test_no_nats_client_returns_degraded and test_publish_nats_connection_error_degrades cover both branches.

completion_promises.criterion_text: On invalid args: returns {'status': 'validation_error', ...} per ADR-ARCH-021; never raises.
completion_promises.evidence: _queue_build_validation_error renders {'status': 'validation_error', 'reason': ..., 'detail': ..., 'correlation_id': ..., 'feature_id': ...}. ValidationError, TypeError, ValueError are all caught at the boundary. TestValidationErrorShape covers invalid_feature_id/repo/adapter/validation.

After successful publish, queue_build calls _forge_subscriber.register_correlation(correlation_id, session_id, adapter, queued_at, feature_id). test_register_correlation_called_with_returned_correlation_id and test_register_correlation_uses_session_id assert call site, args, and correlation_id match.

_fire_and_forget_build_queue_trace builds JarvisRoutingHistoryEntry(subagent_type='forge_build_queue', subagent_task_id=correlation_id) and schedules writer.write_build_queue_dispatch(entry) via asyncio.create_task without awaiting. TestRoutingHistoryWriteOnSuccess validates the schedule.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Reasoning-model attempt to override originating_adapter is silently overridden (Group D #4 security scenario).
completion_promises.evidence: _resolve_originating_adapter consults Session.adapter first; arg fallback only when no session. test_session_adapter_overrides_arg passes Session(adapter=Adapter.CLI) + arg='telegram' from the model — published payload carries 'terminal' (session-derived), confirming the silent override.
